name: interactive-web-studio
description: Premium, cinematic, highly interactive sites — immersive motion, WebGL/Three.js, custom shaders, smooth scroll, scroll-driven storytelling. Best for expressive/experimental directions.

name: capcut-design
description: Clean, modern product UI with an exact token system (color, type, spacing). Best for polished, consistent, restrained directions.

name: webgl-trail-reveal
description: A mouse-trail image-reveal mechanic (calm ↔ dramatic). Best when the site has a strong hero image or a before/after story.

name: exploded-showcase
description: Cinematic 3D product teardown / exploded hero with labeled parts. Best when the site sells a physical product, device or machine.

name: scroll-craft
description: Premium scroll-driven landing pages — layered depth heroes, scroll-as-timeline storytelling, one engineered peak, separate mobile art direction. Best for service, product, food and drink brands.

name: blender-to-web
description: Design and build a "living 3D hero" for any brand or product: a sculptural centerpiece modeled in Blender (reproducible Python, editable .blend, efficient GLB) and brought to life on a website with Three.js — idle motion, hover, click-to…

name: real-estate-reveal
description: Turn a property listing (photos + facts, optionally a Zillow/Redfin/MLS link) into a cinematic luxury real estate website: one continuous scroll-driven camera journey through the real home, from drone approach through the rooms to the po…

name: impeccable
description: Use when the user wants to design, redesign, shape, critique, audit, polish, clarify, distill, harden, optimize, adapt, animate, colorize, extract, or otherwise improve a frontend interface.

name: scroll-world
description: Build an immersive scroll-scrubbed "fly through the world" landing page for any industry or brand, rendered through muapi.ai (Seedance 2 video + GPT Image 2 stills).

name: cinematic-ui
description: Design and build websites with film-inspired visual systems, director-driven art direction, storyboard-first layout planning, and cinematic motion.

name: h3-scroll-world
description: Builds an immersive scroll-scrubbed "fly through the world" landing page for any industry or brand, with MiniMax H3 rendering every video clip and OpenRouter generating the scene stills.

name: frontend-design
description: Anthropic's official design skill: commits to one bold aesthetic direction (brutalist, editorial, luxury, retro-futuristic…) with distinctive type, a committed palette and deliberate motion. Best default when no specialist fits.

name: taste-skill
description: Anti-slop landing pages: infers a real design direction from the brief, audit-first on redesigns, strict pre-flight so nothing looks templated. Best for portfolios, SaaS and brand sites.

name: taste-skill-v1
description: The original taste-skill (v1) behaviour, for when the v2 rewrite drifts. Same anti-template goal, older rule set.

name: soft-skill
description: The "expensive agency" look: exact premium fonts, spacing, soft shadows, card structures and animations; bans cheap AI defaults. Best for high-end service and product brands.

name: minimalist-skill
description: Clean editorial minimalism: warm monochrome, typographic contrast, flat bento grids, muted pastels, no gradients or heavy shadows. Best for calm, content-first sites.

name: brutalist-skill
description: Swiss-print meets military terminal: rigid grids, extreme type-scale contrast, utilitarian colour, analog degradation. Best for data-heavy, editorial or developer sites.

name: gpt-tasteskill
description: GSAP-heavy scroll design: pinning, stacking and scrubbed ScrollTriggers, strict AIDA structure, gapless bento grids, randomized layout variance. Best for bold marketing one-pagers.

name: redesign-skill
description: Upgrade-in-place: audits the existing site for generic AI patterns and lifts it to premium standards without breaking functionality. Best for a subtle-to-medium modernization.

name: stitch-skill
description: Design-system first: writes a strict DESIGN.md (type, calibrated colour, asymmetric layout, micro-motion) then builds from it. Best when the redesign must scale to many pages.

name: imagegen-frontend-web
description: Mockup-first: generates one premium design image per section with varied compositions and one palette, then the build matches it. Best when you want to approve the look visually before code.

name: image-to-code-skill
description: Generates the design images itself, analyzes them deeply, then implements the site to match them closely. Pairs with imagegen-frontend-web.

name: brandkit
description: Rebrand direction: produces a premium brand-guidelines board (logo system, identity, visual world) to drive the redesign's look. Best when the site needs a new identity, not just a new layout.

name: ui-ux-pro-max
description: Design-intelligence database: picks a style, palette, font pairing and UX rules matched to the product type. Best for business apps, SaaS and dashboards.

name: theme-factory
description: Ten curated colour + font themes (or one generated on the fly), applied consistently. Best for a fast, coherent re-theme of a plain site.

name: web-artifacts-builder
description: React + Tailwind + shadcn/ui build bundled into one HTML file. Best for rich, component-heavy prototypes of the redesign.

name: web-design-guidelines
description: Vercel's Web Interface Guidelines as a direction constraint: accessibility, focus states, forms, motion, typography, dark mode. Mix in to make any direction ship-ready.

name: clone-site
description: Measure-first: tears down a reference site you love (exact tokens, motion, shader params) and rebuilds it pixel-accurately. Best when the redesign should look like a specific named site.

name: remix-site
description: Take a cloned or measured site and make it yours: tokenize, re-skin with your brand, three directions side by side, live tweak panel.

name: shader-extract
description: Captures one WebGL / shader / Three.js / Spline / Unicorn Studio effect from a reference page and rebuilds it locally. Mix in when the redesign should borrow a specific animated background.
